1_id_category: r2s2_stacked-B1 — mf_composition / condition→pseudo-LF emulation feeding a real-LF-trained defect corrector, with an in-job attribution decomposition of stacked error into emulator error, distribution shift, and the conditional-mean barrier
2_motivation: The stack topology is not novel and the card claims nothing for it. The websearcher's verdict, verbatim: "D1 — `preempted (cite)`: Xu, Cao, Yuan, Meschke (2023), https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.00057 — frozen LF DeepONet subnet whose predicted LF output feeds a residual subnet; Yang et al. (2025), https://arxiv.org/html/2503.17941v1 — names 'residual-learning frameworks that sequentially combine low and high-fidelity predictions' as an existing class." The stream's claim therefore sits on D2, "`preempted-but-MF-composition-open`", where the report records that no fetched source decomposes stacked error into emulator error + downstream distribution shift, nor uses the frozen−finetuned delta as the shift estimator, on field-valued PDEs, and (report §"Turn 4") that no source was found quantifying a real-LF-trained corrector's degradation on emulated LF inputs. B1 measures a known composition in an unmeasured regime — copy-LF skill, no solver at test, N_hf ∈ {5, 400} — and contributes the attribution. Beyond the pre-directed design, the card adds one thing nobody asked for: ADR r2-0003 established that on pfc / fisher_kpp / allen_cahn the realized IC is absent from the condition vector and present in the LF field, so a condition-only emulator inherits the identical conditional-mean bound. Arm A5 turns that from an argument into a paired in-job measurement.
3_description:
Family `models_r2/r2s2_stack`. A FiLM-FNO emulator (`FNO2d`-class, coords-only input, FiLM on the condition at every block; width 64, 4 blocks, 12×12 modes) maps condition → LF field on the LF rung's native grid (not the HF grid — otherwise the nested-ladder degeneracy is total and the stream's question is unanswerable by construction), trained with relative-L2 against real train LF at `S6_LF_FID=max`. A corrected upsampler (convention keyed per dataset exactly as `round2/eval/panel_data.py`: `node_aligned_periodic` / `dirichlet_node` / `legacy_cell_centred`), vendored into the family dir with provenance, lifts pseudo-LF to the HF working grid — this is round 1's never-applied "corrector-input wrap-seam fix". The round-1 `dc_cleaned` stage is then vendored with provenance from `round1/worktrees/s4_hybrid_routing/B3/models_r1/s4_router/` (`lsi_filter.py` closed-form Wiener `T(k)` + α line-search including 0; `local_corrector.py::LocalCorrector`, `local_pixel_gate`, kernel 7, depth 4, width 32, zero-init head). Router and trust head are removed — round 1 measured their panel contribution at exactly 0.000000 (r1 report §2, §4). One emulator is trained once and shared by all arms, so every arm is an in-job paired control on identical pseudo-LF fields (drift-class rule). "Frozen" means frozen with respect to the pseudo-LF distribution (the corrector is re-fit on real train LF via the corrected data path, and never sees pseudo-LF) — not a round-1 checkpoint, which was fit against the defective reference.

Five scored arms:

| arm | LF input at test | LSI (T, α) fit on | LocalCorrector trained on | role |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A1 `emul_only` | pseudo-LF (upsampled) | — | — | stack's internal floor + in-job direct-condition→HF control |
| A2 `frozen` | pseudo-LF | REAL train LF | REAL train LF cleaned residual | PRIMARY — pure distribution-shift exposure |
| A3 `finetuned` | pseudo-LF | T from A2; α refit on pseudo | init A2, fine-tuned on (pseudo-LF, HF) | A2 − A3 = shift estimator |
| A4 `end_to_end` | pseudo-LF | jointly | emulator + corrector joint, HF loss, init A2 | CALM-PDE §4.3 test |
| A5 `condmean_lf` | train-mean LF (constant) | REAL train LF | REAL train LF cleaned residual | ADR r2-0003 null; A2 − A5 = value of the emulator |

Sidecars on a held-out slice of the TRAIN split only (train LF is legal, §5.9 untouched): S1 emulator field error nRMSE(LF̂, LF_real); S2 real-LF oracle ceiling in-job. Training-free pre-registered probes: P1 BC-match audit (`tools/spectral_prestage_bc_audit.py`, adapted); P2 condition→LF identifiability (ADR r2-0003's nearest-condition method applied to the LF fields), both recorded before training so the falsification is decidable. Six in-process validity gates V1–V6, including V6 `R2S2_REQUIRE_PSEUDO_LF` — the tripwire preventing the silent ifc_poisson no-op that round 1 hit (`S6_FALLBACK_NO_TEST_LF=champion`). Round-1's D3 val-asymmetry defect is repaired: disjoint, identically-sized val sub-slices (`val_a` for α, `val_b` for the gate) identical across arms.
4_expected_result: Primary metric = panel geomean skill of the best stack arm, bracketed by two numbers computed in `summary_so_far.md` §3: the real-LF oracle ceiling 0.3306 (§12.2's mandated restatement of `dc_cleaned`'s 0.1232 under the corrected denominators) and the launch anchor 23.0636. Expected landing: panel geomean ≈ 2–8, i.e. Δ vs anchor = 3–10× better but 10–25× short of the oracle. Why: the geomean is dragged up by the three ADR r2-0003 datasets where the stack is capped at the conditional-mean floor (train_mean skills pfc 59.81 / fisher_kpp 11.99 / allen_cahn 562.03), and pulled down by the datasets whose condition is (near-)complete. Per dataset — cahn_hilliard 3–10 vs NN floor 23.180 (the claim-bearing dataset; Δ ≥ 13 skill units, far above the provisional min_claimable_effect 1.1604 and spread 0.4023); helmholtz 1.5–3 vs zero floor 3.3441 — but its provisional min_claimable_effect 10.6811 exceeds the entire plausible range, so helmholtz stays report-only (r1 report §5.3), carries the standing zero-floor column, and no helmholtz-only claim is made; pfc / fisher_kpp / allen_cahn at or near the train_mean floor with `A2 − A5 ≈ 0` (the pre-registered ADR r2-0003 prediction); ifc_poisson 2–10, anecdote-grade at N_hf = 5 but the DC lineage runs there for the first time. Secondary (the D2 claim): shift penalty `A2 − A3 > 0` and, pre-registering CALM-PDE §4.3's direction, `A4 ≤ A2` — a frozen-arm win would be a reportable inversion. All pfc claims carry the wrap-seam caveat (deep-bulk ratio 0.908) and the band-limited denominator caveat.
expected_falsification: On `sharp__cahn_hilliard` — the one panel dataset whose condition vector is IC-complete (16 of 19 dims are `ic_c*`) and hence the only one where the stacking premise is identifiable at all — the design is falsified if the best stack arm fails to improve on the in-job `emul_only` arm by at least 2.0 skill units and fails to beat the frozen NN-in-condition floor 23.180, both margins exceeding that dataset's provisional noise floor (spread 0.4023, min_claimable_effect 1.1604), since that would show the LF representation is not a useful bottleneck even where the emulator can in principle be accurate.

DEVIATION JUDGED (ifc_poisson unpaired ladder) -- CORRECT AND FAITHFUL TO INTENT. Reviewer independently reproduced the measurement from the stripped view: min nearest-condition distance from each of the 5 HF train samples is 0.1211/0.0819/0.2354/0.1123/0.1731 at rung 8, 0.1834/0.1431/0.2592/0.1601/0.2620 at rung 16, 0.2438/0.0918/0.3041/0.1288/0.1519 at rung 32 -- never 0, matching the builder to the digit; all other panel and guard datasets are exactly index-aligned (max|dX| = 0.0). This AGREES with r2s3's independent websearcher finding (rungs condition-disjoint, 100/50/20/5 samples, no shared rows) -- two streams, two methods, same conclusion. HF - LF_up is genuinely undefined there so A2/A5 cannot be built as worded; the alternatives were worse (mispairing via lf[:n_hf] truncation, which is what round-1's copylf_prediction does, would regress the corrector onto a residual between unrelated samples; hard-failing loses a panel column; silently scoring emul_only changes which arm the geomean uses without saying so). Gate V6b measures the pairing, the DC stage falls back to the pseudo-LF path (paired by construction), and the degradation is surfaced in BOTH the diag and the per-dataset result JSON extra (arm_semantics_degraded, paired_real_lf, dc_fit_source, attribution.valid=False). The card's build_notes[2] states it correctly; only the code strings overreach, and attribution.valid=False is the operative guard. interpretation: I1 (HIGH, directly measured). The stack does not fail because stacking is a bad topology; it fails because stage 1 never learned a map that stage 2 could use. ~100% of the panel error is emulator error, and on 5 of 6 panel datasets the emulator's held-out error equals its in-sample error -- it is not overfitting, it is not fitting.

I2 -> I2' CORRECTION (turn 1's architectural reading is FALSIFIED in its strong form; the replacement is HIGH confidence). Turn 1 read the vendored FNO2d correctly -- coordinates-only input, sample dependence entering only through spatially-constant FiLM gamma/beta -- and inferred that the reachable set is 'a fixed spatial dictionary under a global rescale'. Turn 2 falsified that: the SAME architecture emits a rank-22 field family on cahn_hilliard matching the truth's rank 22, and a rank-6 one on fluid matching the truth's rank 6, and reproduces the truth's band >= 1 pattern-diversity statistic to three decimals on both guards. I2' replaces it: THE EMULATOR'S REACHABLE-SET RANK IS SELECTED BY TRAINING TO MATCH THE NUMBER OF FIELD DIMENSIONS THAT ARE A FUNCTION OF THE CONDITION. Where that number is 1 the network converges to LF_hat(X) = a(X) v -- on pfc an all-but-exactly linear a (R^2 0.99997) -- which is why a 4.78M-parameter operator measured within 0.036-0.125 of a six-parameter ridge. Rank collapse is a CORRECT response to an unlearnable target, not a pathology, and the FiLM path is where it is implemented (code eff-rank ~1.0), not where it is caused.

CEILING TAXONOMY (HIGH confidence; supersedes turn 1's I3, which named cahn_hilliard as the single information ceiling). Every panel column sits in exactly one of three regimes, and the regime -- not the model -- decides what any condition->LF or condition->HF design can achieve there. (a) STRUCTURAL ceiling: pfc, allen_cahn, fisher_kpp. Adjacent conditions (0.13-0.34 sd) give ORTHOGONAL band >= 1 patterns; the realised IC is absent from X, exactly ADR r2-0003. No amount of data at this condition parameterisation removes it; the emulator is already at or past the best training-free condition-only predictor, and the conditional mean is the right answer. (b) SAMPLING ceiling: cahn_hilliard. The 19-dim condition DOES encode the IC (16 ic_c* dims), the emulator emits the right rank (22) and the right pattern diversity, but the median nearest-neighbour condition distance is 3.91 sd -- at N = 320 in 19 dimensions nothing is near anything, and the emulator memorises (in-sample 0.0317 -> held-out 0.4649). This one moves with N, not with architecture. (c) LEARNING gap (the only genuinely movable columns): helmholtz -- the map IS continuous (nearest-neighbour band >= 1 cosine +0.931) yet the FiLM code collapsed to a single knob and the output r99 is 3 against the truth's 5, with resonance-driven amplitude swings that ridge cannot follow (PC1 R^2 -234.7); and ifc_poisson -- a rank-8 PCA + ridge is exact to 6.2e-08 on 16 fit samples while the trained emulator sits at 0.0821. Cross-stream corroboration: r2s3-B1 turn 2 independently proved the ifc condition->field map exactly affine.

I7 (HIGH, directly measured). A defect corrector's value is governed by the COHERENCE OF ITS INPUT'S REALISATION with the target, not by its own capacity or its training budget: identical frozen weights deliver 32-100% error reduction at band-1 coherence ~1.0 and <= 0.08% at coherence <= 0.52, with the correction rotating from cos +0.98 to cos ~0 against the residual it must remove. The threshold lies in 0.52 < gamma_b1 < 0.95 and no panel column except the (degraded) ifc_poisson one is above it.

I8 (HIGH, structural -- the stream's framing answer). X -> LF_hat(X) -> corrector(LF_hat(X), X) is a deterministic function of X and therefore cannot leave the condition->HF hypothesis class: a deterministic pseudo-LF is not an information channel, it is a re-parameterisation. On the structural-ceiling datasets that re-parameterisation carries ~1 effective dimension (turn 2 F7/F8), i.e. one scalar the corrector already had. Empirically the stack sits at or past every training-free condition-only reference on 5/6 panel datasets with the corrector contributing <= 0.08% of that margin. The stream's own falsification framing -- 'if pseudo-LF -> corrector loses to direct condition->HF models, the LF representation is not a useful bottleneck' -- is therefore answered in the stronger form: through a DETERMINISTIC emulator the LF representation cannot be a useful bottleneck, whatever the emulator's quality; the only route by which stage 2 can pay is matching the corrector to the emulator's realised output distribution.

I9 (MEDIUM, actionable). The single configuration in this job where stage 2 moved the panel geomean is ifc_poisson, where the unpaired-ladder fallback accidentally fitted the corrector on the emulator's own output -- i.e. A3 (finetuned) semantics arriving by accident. If the stream continues, the informative contrast is not frozen-on-real-LF (measured worth <= 0.08% on every paired panel dataset) but a budget-matched frozen-vs-fitted-on-pseudo comparison; the card's own A2-A3 estimator is confounded by A3's 50% larger optimizer budget (part 5 reviewer caveat F8).

I10 (MEDIUM, cross-stream). The corrector-value law is a TRAINING-FREE ELIGIBILITY TEST: per-band coherence between a candidate LF surrogate and the HF target is computable before any corrector is trained and predicts whether a downstream corrector is worth building. It extends round 1's BC-match rule from 'is the filter applicable' to 'is the input worth filtering', and applies to any design that feeds a learned intermediate into a downstream corrector (r2s3's distillation arms included).
6_analysis.falsification_postmortem: The clause was a CONJUNCTION and did not fire, because conjunct 2 failed decisively (the best stack arm beat the NN-in-condition floor 23.180 by 11.90 skill units, 130x the certified noise floor). Conjunct 1 -- 'fails to improve on the in-job emul_only arm by at least 2.0 skill units' -- HELD, by 326x the threshold (measured improvement 0.0061 skill units) and 15x the certified per-dataset noise floor 0.0912. Mechanism, now measured rather than asserted: (i) the stack's error on cahn_hilliard is 99.98% stage-1 error (S2 sidecar: the same frozen corrector fed REAL LF reaches 0.0059 on the same held-out slice, fed pseudo-LF 0.4638); (ii) the pseudo-LF's band >= 1 content is at coherence 0.516 with the HF target against 0.997 for real LF, so the corrector's correction vector rotates from cos +0.9846 to cos +0.0585 against the residual and its relative value-add falls 391x (0.3209 -> 0.00082) along the interpolation from real to pseudo input; (iii) the trained neural branch was gated OUT entirely there (alpha_nn = 0.0), leaving only the closed-form LSI filter, and (iv) the IN-SAMPLE ORACLE Wiener filter -- an upper bound on ANY spatially-invariant linear stage on that input -- is worth 14.07% relative, i.e. ~1.59 skill units transferred multiplicatively to the scored arm (0.47149 -> 0.40515, skill 11.279 -> 9.692), STILL BELOW the clause's own 2.0-skill-unit threshold. Conjunct 1 was therefore not falsifiable by any better corrector of the class the card specified; it was decided by the emulator before stage 2 ran. The clause was well-posed but mis-targeted: it tested the composition on the one dataset where the condition is IC-complete, which turn 2 re-diagnosed as a SAMPLING ceiling (median nearest-condition distance 3.91 sd at N = 320 in 19 dims) rather than the clean identifiability case it was written for. The correctly-targeted version of the same test is a coherence precondition: require gamma_band1(pseudo-LF, HF) >= ~0.95 before asking a corrector to add skill.
surprises: The falsification clause's own threshold was unreachable in principle: even an ORACLE in-sample Wiener filter on the realised pseudo-LF is worth ~1.59 skill units on cahn_hilliard, below the clause's 2.0. A pre-registered clause can be structurally unfalsifiable given a stage-1 result nobody had measured yet.

The corrector's collapse is not gradual. A 10% admixture of pseudo-LF into a real-LF input already costs 7.7x (pfc), 48x (allen_cahn) and 7.1x (cahn_hilliard) of its value, and drives cos(correction, residual) from ~+0.98 to +0.009...+0.26. 'Distribution shift' understates it: the correction is nearly orthogonal to what it must remove.

The NEURAL part of the correction turns actively wrong-signed off the real-LF point (cos = -0.298 on allen_cahn, -0.357 on fisher_kpp at t=0.1) while shrinking its own magnitude by 20-40x. The zero-initialised gate is what keeps this harmless -- an ungated corrector would have made the stack worse.

Turn 1's architectural hypothesis (I2) was falsified by the same architecture on a different dataset: coords-only + global FiLM emits a rank-22 field family on cahn_hilliard and matches the guards' pattern-diversity statistic to three decimals. A correct code reading plus a correct symptom prediction can still be the wrong mechanism.

helmholtz's corrector is an exact no-op in BOTH branches (alpha_lsi = 0.0 and alpha_nn = 0.0) -- the pre-registered V5 prediction covered only the LSI branch; the line search including zero independently switched off the neural branch too. The scored helmholtz column is the bare emulator.
On the guard set the corrector works BETTER on pseudo-LF than on real LF (fluid value-add 0.6289 vs 0.6094) -- when the emulator is accurate, its output is the smoother, better-conditioned input.

The card's whole all-6 geomean gain over its own emulator floor (24.68 -> 14.08) comes from ifc_poisson, the one column where an UNPAIRED-ladder fallback accidentally fitted the corrector on the emulator's own output. The stream's most interesting positive result is a build-time accident, and it is the A3 arm in disguise.

7_gap_and_future.open_question: Can ANY realisation-aware stage 1 -- an emulator that samples from the distribution of LF fields consistent with the condition instead of returning E[LF | c] -- restore the band>=1 coherence a defect corrector needs, or is the stacked class dead on this benchmark? The measurement that makes this the sharp question: the corrector's value is a step function of its input's REALISATION, not of its own capacity (identical frozen weights: 32-100% error reduction at gamma_band1 ~ 1.0, <= 0.08% at gamma_band1 <= 0.52, cos(correction, residual) +0.98 -> ~0, a 10% pseudo admixture already costing 7-48x of the value; turn 3 F13/F14/F15). A conditional-MEAN emulator provably cannot clear that bar on the structural-ceiling columns -- adjacent conditions 0.13-0.34 sd apart carry ORTHOGONAL band>=1 content (turn 2 F10), so E[LF | c] has no band>=1 realisation to be coherent with, and the rank-1 output the network converged to is the correct answer to the question it was asked. A SAMPLE from p(LF | c) does have full band>=1 amplitude -- but a sample drawn independently of the test field's own realisation has coherence 0 with it in expectation, so the corrector's input is no better aligned and the arm's per-sample relative error gets WORSE than the conditional mean's (the classic mean-vs-sample trade under an L2-relative metric). The question is therefore whether there is any middle object -- a posterior sample conditioned on something the test row actually exposes, an ensemble whose spread the corrector consumes as an uncertainty channel, or a metric/target change that stops rewarding the blurred mean -- for which coherence exceeds the 0.52-0.95 threshold band this card only bracketed. If the answer is no, `condition -> pseudo-LF -> corrector` should be closed as a class for this benchmark and the finding written up as such (it is a clean negative with a mechanism, not a null result).
7_gap_and_future.next_direction:
Two mutually exclusive B2 options; pick ONE, and note the second is the safer scientific bet.

(A) REALISATION-AWARE STAGE 1 ON cahn_hilliard ONLY. This is the one column where the ceiling is SAMPLING, not information (19-dim condition, 16 ic_c* dims, emulator emits the right rank 22 and the right band>=1 pattern diversity 0.411 vs the truth's 0.389, but median nearest-condition distance is 3.91 sd at N=320 and it memorises: in-sample 0.0317 -> held-out 0.4649; turn 2 F7/F9/F10). It is also the only column where an LSI stage on the CURRENT pseudo-LF has any headroom at all (+14.07% oracle, 1.59 skill units). Pre-register the falsification in coherence units, not skill units: the arm must lift gamma_band1(surrogate, HF) from 0.516 to >= 0.95 on the held-out TRAIN slice -- measurable with `tools/surrogate_coherence_eligibility.py` BEFORE any corrector is trained, which makes the batch cheap to abandon. Concrete levers, in cost order: a condition-space metric that makes 19-D neighbours meaningful (learned/whitened distance, since Euclidean at 3.91 sd is the binding defect), more HF/LF samples if generation is in scope, then an explicitly stochastic head. Risk, stated: even at the ceiling this column is worth ~1.6 skill units against a panel geomean of 14.08, so a WIN here does not move the round's headline.

(B) PIVOT THE STREAM TO THE TWO LEARNING-FAILURE COLUMNS. `ext__helmholtz_2d` and `ifc_poisson` are the only panel columns where the emulator class demonstrably CAN fit and did not: helmholtz's cond->field map is continuous (nearest-neighbour band>=1 cosine +0.931) yet the trained FiLM code collapsed to a single knob (code eff-rank 1.00 in all four blocks) and output r99 is 3 against the truth's 5, because resonance drives band-0 amplitude swings of 0.598 relative between neighbours that a ridge cannot follow (PC1 R^2 -234.7); ifc_poisson's LF field is an exact affine function of the 5-dim condition (ridge held-out 0.0000, rank-8 PCA+ridge 6.2e-08) while the trained emulator sits at 0.0821 on 16 fit rows. Both are amplitude/conditioning defects with cheap fixes (amplitude-aware or log-amplitude loss and a factorised direction x amplitude head for helmholtz; a linear-in-condition head or a closed-form warm start for ifc_poisson), both are diagnosable training-free with `reachable_set_rank_audit.py --gen_conds` + one forward pass, and both are worth more skill than (A) -- helmholtz alone is 2.82 skill units against a 3.34 zero floor with r2s4's comparator at 6.94, and ifc_poisson's emulator error is what the whole degraded column rests on. NOTE the constraint that makes this a PIVOT and not a continuation: closing either gap improves a condition->HF model, not a stack. Per I8 the corrector cannot pay on either column (helmholtz's alpha_lsi = alpha_nn = 0.0 by its own line search; ifc_poisson is unpaired), so option (B) should be run as a condition->HF card and coordinated with r2s1/r2s4 rather than as another stacking arm.

Do NOT re-run the frozen-vs-finetuned contrast as the card specified it: A2-A3 is confounded by A3's 50% larger optimizer budget (part 5 reviewer caveat F8) and, on the five paired columns, the whole contrast is worth <= 0.08%. If it is run at all, run it budget-matched and only on a surrogate that has already passed the coherence precondition.
7_gap_and_future.cross_stream_notes:
1. I8 IS A ROUND-LEVEL CONSTRAINT, NOT A STREAM RESULT. X -> g(X) -> f(g(X), X) is a deterministic function of X; a learned intermediate field is a RE-PARAMETERISATION of the condition->HF hypothesis class, never a new information channel. Any round-2 design that routes a condition through an intermediate representation (distillation, pseudo-LF, latent field, warm-started ladder) inherits the same ceiling as a direct condition->HF model of equal capacity, and must be judged against a direct model at matched budget rather than against copy-LF. This card is the empirical version: the stack sits at or past every training-free condition-only reference on 5/6 panel datasets with the corrector contributing <= 0.08% of the margin. It connects r2s4's conditional-mean barrier (the ceiling this class cannot cross) and r2s1's capacity finding (a <=156-parameter closed-form head matching a 15.9 M-parameter decoder): all three are the same statement in different coordinates -- when the condition determines 1-3 field dimensions, everything downstream of the condition is bookkeeping.
2. THE CONCRETE FIXABLES ARE ifc_poisson AND ext__helmholtz_2d, AND THEY ARE CROSS-STREAM. This card's ifc_poisson finding (LF field EXACTLY affine in the 5-dim condition, ridge held-out 0.0000 on 16 rows, trained emulator 0.0821) is independent corroboration of r2s3-B1 turn 2 (cond->field affine to 3.2e-08 LOO, seven orders of magnitude away from every other panel dataset) reached from the LF-field side rather than the condition-design side -- two streams, two methods, same conclusion, and it means any family that does not reduce to a closed form on ifc_poisson is leaving the column on the table. The helmholtz FiLM-collapse (condition->code MLP eff-rank 1.00/1.00/1.00/1.00 out of 128 channels while the map is continuous at nn cosine +0.931) is a defect of the shared FiLM conditioning path, which r2s1's and r2s4's families use too: worth checking the same statistic there before attributing a helmholtz result to capacity or to data.
3. A TRAINING-FREE PRECONDITION EVERY STREAM CAN USE. Before building any stage that CORRECTS a learned intermediate, compute the intermediate's per-band coherence with the target and the in-sample ORACLE Wiener ceiling (`tools/surrogate_coherence_eligibility.py`). r2s2-B1's clause would have been retired before stage 2 was built: the oracle ceiling on the realised pseudo-LF was 1.59 skill units against a 2.0-skill-unit threshold. This extends round 1's BC-match rule from 'is the filter applicable' to 'is the input worth filtering'.
4. A METHOD WARNING FOR CLAUSE AUTHORS. This card's falsification clause was structurally unfalsifiable given a stage-1 result nobody had measured yet. Where a clause is conditional on an unmeasured upstream quantity, state the threshold in that quantity (here: gamma_band1 >= 0.95) rather than in end-to-end skill units.
